lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white line segments; inter-line spacing is widest at the mid-torso and narrower towards the anterior and posterior boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most posterior line segment is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct circular white spots clustered on the lower posterior haunch, positioned superior to the white hair transition on the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns diverge laterally and posteriorly from the skull base before converging medially at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated distance between terminal tips is 3.2 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the distal 12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the lateral torso and neck; prominent white dorsal fringe and white facial chevron between the eyes.
